$comment: Pickle Brawl's whole backend, run by a node (node/publisher-services.js): the accounts API, the Open Play / lobby matchmaker, and two courts the matchmaker leases. Published at <wsAddr>/svc/pickle-brawl.<name>; the game finds them through NodeDirectory. In node.env: SERVICES=<absolute path to this file> and GAUNTLET_GATEWAY_PORT=8478 (the gateway; the relay tunnel fronts it). cwd is a RUNTIME checkout pinned to the commit the live web build came from (git worktree add ../pb-runtime <commit>; pnpm install in the root, services/api and services/matchmaker; the .dist/game.js that build shipped), so the courts run the same engine as the players' browsers; move it forward only together with the web build. envFiles are the development checkout's own .env files (secrets read in place, never copied). COURT_IDENTITY is the court key (npm run bridge -- key --kind attested --ruleset pickle-brawl.v1); the node lists it in COURTS so court results settle on the ladder. Machine-specific: copy and edit.
